**Accepting Petri Net Construction (Insurance Claim Process)**

```python
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj import PetriNet, Marking
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.utils import petri_utils

net = PetriNet(name="insurance_claim_management")

# Places (states)
p_start = PetriNet.Place("p_start")
p_after_C = PetriNet.Place("p_after_C")
p_after_CR = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CR")
p_after_DV = PetriNet.Place("p_after_DV")
p_after_RDS = PetriNet.Place("p_after_RDS")
p_after_FC = PetriNet.Place("p_after_FC")
p_after_II = PetriNet.Place("p_after_II")
p_after_CA = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CA")
p_after_AP = PetriNet.Place("p_after_AP")
p_after_P = PetriNet.Place("p_after_P")
p_after_N = PetriNet.Place("p_after_N")
p_end = PetriNet.Place("p_end")

net.places.add(p_start)
net.places.add(p_after_C)
net.places.add(p_after_CR)
net.places.add(p_after_DV)
net.places.add(p_after_RDS)
net.places.add(p_after_FC)
net.places.add(p_after_II)
net.places.add(p_after_CA)
net.places.add(p_after_AP)
net.places.add(p_after_P)
net.places.add(p_after_N)
net.places.add(p_end)

# Transitions (activities)
t_C = PetriNet.Transition("C", "Insurance Claim")
t_CR = PetriNet.Transition("CR", "Claim Registration")
t_DV = PetriNet.Transition("DV", "Document Verification")
t_RDS = PetriNet.Transition("RDS", "Re-Document Submission")
t_FC = PetriNet.Transition("FC", "Fraud Check")
t_II = PetriNet.Transition("II", "In-depth Investigation")
t_CA = PetriNet.Transition("CA", "Claim Assessment")
t_AP = PetriNet.Transition("AP", "Approval")
t_P = PetriNet.Transition("P", "Payment")
t_N = PetriNet.Transition("N", "Notification")
t_CL = PetriNet.Transition("CL", "Closure")

net.transitions.add(t_C)
net.transitions.add(t_CR)
net.transitions.add(t_DV)
net.transitions.add(t_RDS)
net.transitions.add(t_FC)
net.transitions.add(t_II)
net.transitions.add(t_CA)
net.transitions.add(t_AP)
net.transitions.add(t_P)
net.transitions.add(t_N)
net.transitions.add(t_CL)

# Control-flow arcs
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_start, t_C, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_C, p_after_C, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_C, t_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CR, p_after_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CR, t_DV, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_DV, p_after_DV, net)

# DV -> RDS loop
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_RDS, p_after_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_RDS, t_DV, net)

# DV -> FC
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_FC, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_FC, p_after_FC, net)

# FC -> II loop
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_II, p_after_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_II, t_FC, net)

# FC -> CA
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CA, p_after_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CA, t_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_AP, p_after_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_AP, t_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_P, p_after_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_P, t_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_N, p_after_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_N, t_CL, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CL, p_end, net)

# Markings
im = Marking()
im[p_start] = 1

fm = Marking()
fm[p_end] = 1
```

**Control-flow semantics captured:**
- Sequential flow C → CR → DV → FC → CA → AP → P → N → CL
- Invisible choice at `p_after_DV` (continue to FC or loop via RDS)
- Invisible choice at `p_after_FC` (continue to CA or loop via II)
- Arbitrary repetitions of RDS and II allowed (as described)
- Single token flow; final marking reached exactly when CL completes.

**Refined Accepting Petri Net (Iteration 2)**

The previous model contained an unnecessary artificial transition `C` and an extra place. The scenario states that a customer *files* an Insurance Claim, after which the listed activities begin. Hence the first visible activity is **Claim Registration (CR)**.

Below is the corrected and minimized accepting Petri net:

```python
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj import PetriNet, Marking
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.utils import petri_utils

net = PetriNet(name="insurance_claim_management")

# Places
p_start = PetriNet.Place("p_start")
p_after_CR = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CR")
p_after_DV = PetriNet.Place("p_after_DV")
p_after_RDS = PetriNet.Place("p_after_RDS")
p_after_FC = PetriNet.Place("p_after_FC")
p_after_II = PetriNet.Place("p_after_II")
p_after_CA = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CA")
p_after_AP = PetriNet.Place("p_after_AP")
p_after_P = PetriNet.Place("p_after_P")
p_after_N = PetriNet.Place("p_after_N")
p_end = PetriNet.Place("p_end")

for p in [p_start, p_after_CR, p_after_DV, p_after_RDS, p_after_FC,
          p_after_II, p_after_CA, p_after_AP, p_after_P, p_after_N, p_end]:
    net.places.add(p)

# Transitions
t_CR = PetriNet.Transition("CR", "Claim Registration")
t_DV = PetriNet.Transition("DV", "Document Verification")
t_RDS = PetriNet.Transition("RDS", "Re-Document Submission")
t_FC = PetriNet.Transition("FC", "Fraud Check")
t_II = PetriNet.Transition("II", "In-depth Investigation")
t_CA = PetriNet.Transition("CA", "Claim Assessment")
t_AP = PetriNet.Transition("AP", "Approval")
t_P = PetriNet.Transition("P", "Payment")
t_N = PetriNet.Transition("N", "Notification")
t_CL = PetriNet.Transition("CL", "Closure")

for t in [t_CR, t_DV, t_RDS, t_FC, t_II, t_CA, t_AP, t_P, t_N, t_CL]:
    net.transitions.add(t)

# Arcs
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_start, t_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CR, p_after_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CR, t_DV, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_DV, p_after_DV, net)

# DV <-> RDS loop
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_RDS, p_after_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_RDS, t_DV, net)

# DV -> FC
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_FC, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_FC, p_after_FC, net)

# FC <-> II loop (multiple times allowed)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_II, p_after_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_II, t_FC, net)

# FC -> CA -> AP -> P -> N -> CL
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CA, p_after_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CA, t_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_AP, p_after_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_AP, t_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_P, p_after_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_P, t_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_N, p_after_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_N, t_CL, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CL, p_end, net)

# Markings
im = Marking()
im[p_start] = 1

fm = Marking()
fm[p_end] = 1
```

**Key semantics preserved:**
- Initial transition = CR (first explicit activity)
- Silent choice after DV and after FC for looping vs. proceeding
- Arbitrary repetitions of RDS and II via cycles
- Sound linear path to final marking exactly when CL fires
- No silent transitions; all labels visible and match the scenario

This model is ready for the final synthesis.

**Final Answer: Accepting Petri Net for the Insurance Claim Process**

```python
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.obj import PetriNet, Marking
from pm4py.objects.petri_net.utils import petri_utils

net = PetriNet(name="insurance_claim_management")

# Places (states between activities)
p_start = PetriNet.Place("p_start")
p_after_CR = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CR")
p_after_DV = PetriNet.Place("p_after_DV")
p_after_RDS = PetriNet.Place("p_after_RDS")
p_after_FC = PetriNet.Place("p_after_FC")
p_after_II = PetriNet.Place("p_after_II")
p_after_CA = PetriNet.Place("p_after_CA")
p_after_AP = PetriNet.Place("p_after_AP")
p_after_P = PetriNet.Place("p_after_P")
p_after_N = PetriNet.Place("p_after_N")
p_end = PetriNet.Place("p_end")

for p in [p_start, p_after_CR, p_after_DV, p_after_RDS, p_after_FC,
          p_after_II, p_after_CA, p_after_AP, p_after_P, p_after_N, p_end]:
    net.places.add(p)

# Transitions (activities)
t_CR = PetriNet.Transition("CR", "Claim Registration")
t_DV = PetriNet.Transition("DV", "Document Verification")
t_RDS = PetriNet.Transition("RDS", "Re-Document Submission")
t_FC = PetriNet.Transition("FC", "Fraud Check")
t_II = PetriNet.Transition("II", "In-depth Investigation")
t_CA = PetriNet.Transition("CA", "Claim Assessment")
t_AP = PetriNet.Transition("AP", "Approval")
t_P = PetriNet.Transition("P", "Payment")
t_N = PetriNet.Transition("N", "Notification")
t_CL = PetriNet.Transition("CL", "Closure")

for t in [t_CR, t_DV, t_RDS, t_FC, t_II, t_CA, t_AP, t_P, t_N, t_CL]:
    net.transitions.add(t)

# Arcs - main sequence
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_start, t_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CR, p_after_CR, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CR, t_DV, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_DV, p_after_DV, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_FC, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_FC, p_after_FC, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CA, p_after_CA, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_CA, t_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_AP, p_after_AP, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_AP, t_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_P, p_after_P, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_P, t_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_N, p_after_N, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_N, t_CL, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_CL, p_end, net)

# Loop arcs for Re-Document Submission (after DV)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_DV, t_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_RDS, p_after_RDS, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_RDS, t_DV, net)

# Loop arcs for In-depth Investigation (after FC)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_FC, t_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(t_II, p_after_II, net)
petri_utils.add_arc_from_to(p_after_II, t_FC, net)

# Initial and Final markings
im = Marking()
im[p_start] = 1

fm = Marking()
fm[p_end] = 1
```

This Petri net correctly implements the described insurance claim process:
- Starts with a token in `p_start` (new claim arrival).
- Follows the mandatory sequence: **CR → DV → FC → CA → AP → P → N → CL**.
- Allows zero or more **RDS** loops after **DV** (via the cycle through `p_after_RDS`).
- Allows zero or more **II** loops after **FC** (via the cycle through `p_after_II`).
- Reaches the final marking exactly when the claim is closed.
- All transitions are visibly labeled with the activity names given in the scenario.

The model is sound, contains no silent transitions, and satisfies the requirements for an accepting Petri net in PM4Py.
